notes.title: Calling All Ooga Players!!
notes.content:
Hello! If you are a big player of Ooga, please join our [url=https://www.discord.gg/BCCPPHj]Discord Server[/url], in the game's Extras menu, or on the left bar of our Steam page. Let us know you wanna playtest when you join! Happy oog-ing!
